title: Harbor Advisory Corp MA Has $3.42 Million Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Harbor Advisory Corp MA reduced its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 10.8% during the 2nd quarter, HoldingsChannel.com reports. The firm owned 18,449 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 2,243 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises approximately 3.1% of Harbor Advisory Corp MA’s holdings, making the stock its 15th biggest position. Harbor Advisory Corp MA’s holdings in Apple were worth $3,415,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
A number of other institutional investors and hedge funds also recently made changes to their positions in AAPL. Fusion Family Wealth LLC lifted its position in Apple by 54.5% during the 1st quarter. Fusion Family Wealth LLC now owns 12,021 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,017,000 after buying an additional 4,238 shares in the last quarter. Good Life Advisors LLC lifted its position in Apple by 7.4% during the 1st quarter. Good Life Advisors LLC now owns 24,962 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,179,000 after buying an additional 1,729 shares in the last quarter. Dynamic Advisor Solutions LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 128.2% during the 1st quarter. Dynamic Advisor Solutions LLC now owns 49,875 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $8,368,000 after purchasing an additional 28,021 shares during the last quarter. WealthTrust Axiom LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 65.7% during the 1st quarter. WealthTrust Axiom LLC now owns 31,475 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $5,280,000 after purchasing an additional 12,480 shares during the last quarter. Shares of AAPL stock opened at $215.09 on Thursday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a current ratio of 1.31 and a quick ratio of 1.24. The stock has a market capitalization of $1,084.53 billion, a PE ratio of 23.35, a P/E/G ratio of 1.69 and a beta of 1.36. Apple Inc. has a one year low of $150.24 and a one year high of $233.47.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its earnings results on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a return on equity of 43.50% and a net margin of 21.98%. The business had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $52.43 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the business earned $1.67 EPS. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 17.3% compared to the same quarter last year. As a group, sell-side analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.

BMO Capital Markets boosted their price objective on Apple from $184.00 to $199.00 and gave the stock a “market perform” rating in a report on Wednesday, August 1st. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Macquarie reissued a “buy” rating and set a $214.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, August 1st. Finally, Sanford C. Bernstein reissued a “neutral” rating and set a $200.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, August 1st. Three investment analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have issued a hold rating and thirty-one have issued a buy rating to the company’s stock. The stock presently has an average rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $224.63.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
